scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 40s).

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly ask for a PIN, address, or security question to verify the customer's identity and PASS the 'Verified customer' criterion.

scorecard.name: Set proper expectations
scorecard.coaching: Before initiating any action that takes more than a few seconds, inform the customer of the expected duration and any potential wait time, even if other next steps are communicated well.

scorecard.name: Provided the appropriate solution
scorecard.coaching: The agent should have escalated the issue to a supervisor or a specialist who could have provided a more effective solution, rather than repeatedly suggesting the same troubleshooting steps.

result.summary: Customer reports modem issue, no internet, despite reboot attempts. Agent suggests troubleshooting steps, but no resolution.
